newsitem.title: USA: Premier, Central and Southern to merge.
newsitem.headline: Premier, Central and Southern to merge.

text.p: Premier Bancshares Inc said Monday that its shareholders and those of Central and Southern Holding Co Inc approved the merger of the companies.
Shares of Central and Southern Holding Co will be exchanged on a one-for-one share basis for Premier Bancshares stock at the close of trading on June 23, Premier said.
The merged organization will be based in Atlanta and will continue to operate as Premier Bancshares Inc.
Following the closing of the merger, Premier said it will have total assets of about $544 million, shareholders' equity of $48 million and a market capitalization of about $136 million.

Premier CEO Darrell Pittard said the transaction will result in Central and Southern holders getting about 46 percent of the combined institution's 7.9 million shares outstanding, or about $62.5 million in Premier stock.
